test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of persons who eat a particular food for dinner every day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f53fa4969494cf3c324bbbb29da0c8c90e85e7060cfa77fe8cca1fe55e814f8.png] 

How many people eat potatoes and eggs for dinner but NOT chickens?
solution:
• The shaded part represents people eat potatoes and eggs for dinner but NOT chickens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7846f39ae9d4956ba45efc62caf2e48cd2afc7a168feb1adde936276b837a121.png] 

 
• The number representing people eat potatoes and eggs for dinner but NOT chickens = 21.Hence, ‘21’ is the correct answer.
